gw.already_synced: the gateway is already synced with a panel (reset: python -m deployra_gateway reset-pairing)

ban.private: {target} is a private/local address — those can't be banned
ban.too_wide: {target} is too wide a range (at most /16 for IPv4 and /32 for IPv6)

gw.bundle_missing: {path} is missing — the gateway image is incomplete
gw.cant_remove_panel: the panel can't be removed from the tunnel
gw.check_refused: connection refused — nothing listens on that port (or there's no route through the tunnel)
gw.key_mismatch: the private key doesn't match the certificate
gw.key_taken: this key is already assigned to another peer
gw.lego_failed: lego failed (check the domain's DNS and that port 80 is reachable)
gw.lego_no_files: lego didn't create the certificate files
gw.locked: too many failed attempts — try again in a few minutes

log.need_public_host: Set DEPLOYRA_PUBLIC_HOST (this VPS's public address/IP) — nodes need to know where to connect
log.nginx_base_updated: Updated the base nginx config (nginx.conf from the gateway image)
log.no_cloudflared: cloudflared is missing from the gateway image
log.no_wg_tools: wireguard-tools missing — the hub won't start
log.waiting_sync: Deployra-WG is waiting to sync with the Deployra panel.

gw.nginx_pending: nginx isn't responding (container down?) — the config will be used on start
gw.no_lego: lego is missing from the gateway image
gw.not_waiting: the gateway isn't waiting for a sync
gw.token_expired: the token expired — generate a new one in the panel
gw.token_used: this token was already used by another node

unknown_host.text: This domain is not configured in Deployra.
unknown_host.title: Unknown host

gw.url_scheme: the address must start with http:// or https://

node.already_paired: the node is already paired — reset pairing on the node

app.busy: this app is being deployed right now
app.crashed: ✖ The container didn't start. Last logs:
app.endpoint_down: ⚠ Endpoint {endpoint} unavailable (CT stopped?) — removing only the app record
app.other_endpoint: the app runs on another endpoint — delete it and deploy again to move it
app.site_updated: Site files updated from the repository
app.static_ready: ✔ Static site ready (site server on port {port})

compose.bad_name: stack name: lowercase letters, digits, - and _
compose.no_program: program {name} is missing from the backend image
compose.no_service: no service {name} in the compose file
compose.no_services: the compose file needs a services section

node.endpoint_missing: endpoint {endpoint} doesn't exist or the CT isn't running
node.gateway_mismatch: the gateway's reply doesn't match the request

log.fake_docker: DEPLOYRA_FAKE_DOCKER=1 — fake Docker, nothing really runs
log.join_needs_gateway: DEPLOYRA_JOIN needs DEPLOYRA_GATEWAY (the gateway address, e.g. vps.example.com:51821)
log.join_retry: Joining the gateway failed: {error}. Retrying in {delay} s
log.joined_waiting: The node joined the gateway and waits for the panel to finish pairing through the tunnel
log.no_iptables: No iptables — the port pool isn't restricted to the tunnel
log.no_wg_tools: wireguard-tools (wg, wg-quick) missing — the tunnel won't start
log.tunnel_down: The tunnel didn't come up — the API listens on all interfaces (protected by signatures)
log.waiting_pair: The node is waiting to be paired with the Deployra panel.

node.no_free_port: no free port in the pool
node.not_waiting: the node isn't waiting for pairing
node.pair_locked: too many failed pairing attempts — try again in a few minutes

placeholder.heading: Your site is ready 🚀
placeholder.text: Upload files via SFTP or the panel. Site identifier:

sftp.bad_login: SFTP login: lowercase letters, digits, . _ - (2–32 characters)
sftp.need_auth: enter a password or a public key

node.stack_unmanaged: this stack isn't managed by Deployra (no compose file)

static.starting: Starting the shared static site server ({image}) on port {port}

node.system_container: this is a Deployra system container — remove it with docker compose

zip.too_big: the archive is too big once unpacked
zip.too_many: too many files in the archive (> {max})

auth.stream_not_allowed: streaming upload isn't allowed on this endpoint
auth.ts_window: timestamp outside the window (check the clock/NTP)
auth.unknown_key: unknown key or the component isn't paired

pair.bad_code: wrong pairing code or a tampered message
pair.no_kind: the pairing message must have a kind field

schema.abs_container_path: the path in the container must be absolute
schema.bad_slug: slug: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (max 40 characters)
schema.dns_needs_token: the DNS challenge needs a Cloudflare token
schema.need_port: enter the port the app listens on
schema.need_repo: enter a repository URL (https:// or ssh)
schema.proxy_needs_upstream: a proxy host needs a target (upstream)
schema.redirect_needs_domain: a redirect needs a target domain
schema.relative_paths: paths in the repository must be relative
schema.static_local: static sites run on the node host's Docker (local endpoint)
schema.volume_source: source: a volume name or an absolute path
schema.wildcard_dns: a wildcard certificate needs the DNS challenge (Cloudflare)

upd.no_updater: no updater — run the component from a compose file in deploy/ (the *-updater service) or update manually
upd.running: the update to {version} is already running
